name: Western Cape

known.via: English Wikipedia "Western Cape (wine)" (redirects to "Western Cape wine")

soil.rock: Sandstone is sand bound into rock. It weathers to light, sandy soil that drains freely. Shale and mudstone are fine-grained rocks that hold heat well and are moderately fertile.

land: The high ground runs about 12°F cooler than the low ground. Higher vineyards ripen later and keep more acidity, so one grape can make lighter or richer wine here depending on height.

winkler: Big crops are possible, but quality tops out at acceptable.
